findings.title: canManage() grants manage on all groups to holders of only the VIEW scope
findings.body: The no-arg `canManage()` evaluates `hasPermission(null, AdminPermissionsSchema.VIEW, AdminPermissionsSchema.MANAGE)`, i.e. it returns true if the admin only has the `view` scope on the Groups resource type. `GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup()` calls `auth.groups().requireManage()`, so an admin granted only all-groups `view` can create top-level groups (and any other check routed through `canManage()`), which is a privilege escalation. It should only check `MANAGE`.

findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission returns authz resource IDs instead of group IDs, and permission lookup by resource id fails
findings.body: In the `findByType` callback, `hasPermission(groupResource.getId(), ...)` is called, but `hasPermission` resolves the resource via `resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId)` and the Groups resources are named by the *group id* (see `AdminPermissionsSchema.resolveGroup`, which returns `group.getId()` as the resource name). Passing the authz resource UUID therefore never matches, so the method silently falls back to the all-groups resource evaluation and the per-group `view-members`/`manage-members` grants are ignored. Likewise the IDs added to `granted` are authz resource IDs, but the returned set is used as `UserModel.GROUPS` in `UsersResource.searchForUser`/`getUsersCount` and `BruteForceUsersResource`, where group IDs are expected, so user searches/counts scoped by group membership return wrong results. Use `groupResource.getName()` in both places.

findings.title: Possible NullPointerException when the Groups resource-type resource is absent
findings.body: `AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceTypeResource(...)` returns null when admin permissions are not enabled for the resource server, when the resource type is unknown, or when the 'Groups' resource is missing from the store. The returned value is used immediately in `policyStore.findByResource(server, resource)` and `resource.getScopes()` without a null check, causing an NPE instead of a clean deny. Add a null guard returning false.

findings.title: Javadoc for requireManageMembers references the wrong method
findings.body: The Javadoc above `requireManageMembers(GroupModel)` states it throws if `canManageMembership(GroupModel)` returns false; it actually delegates to `canManageMembers(GroupModel)`. The duplicated doc is misleading for implementors of the interface.

findings.title: getResourceName does not resolve names for the new Groups resource type
findings.body: `getResourceName` only special-cases `USERS`; for the newly added `GROUPS` resource type it falls through to `resource.getDisplayName()`. Since group resources are stored with the raw group id as name and no display name, the admin UI/REST representation of a group-scoped permission will show an empty/raw id instead of the group path or name. Add a Groups branch resolving the group (and 'All groups' for the type resource).
